rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold, and for the kind words at the meetup. I have to pass on a named quote right now — for reasons that have nothing to do with the substance (I'm sorting out some day-job paperwork before I put my name on anything public) — so I can't make your noon deadline tomorrow. If it's useful, I'm happy to talk on background / not-for-attribution so you have context even if you can't quote me by name, either now by email or on a quick call. And I'd welcome being quoted by name once that's sorted, if your piece or a future one is still open to it. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I declined both gracefully, left the door open ("this round" / "once that's sorted"), and for the reporter offered background/not-for-attribution instead.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". rows.quote: Corvid Institute open letter** — both wanted public, named attribution ... I declined both gracefully

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out — this is genuinely useful timing. Here's a concrete, self-contained first task if you're up for it, no particular time pressure: A \"what isn't being measured\" landscape map. Survey the current public AI evals / benchmarks landscape (METR, Apollo, MLCommons, the big lab model cards, academic benchmark papers, etc.) and build a short doc that catalogs: (a) what capability/safety properties are actively being evaluated and by whom, and (b) where you see real gaps — things that seem important but nobody seems to be measuring well. A few pages, informal, citations/links welcome. This directly feeds a decision we're making about where a small independent effort could actually add something rather than duplicate existing work. No need to put your name on anything public yet — this is internal for now. Happy to hop on a call first if it's easier to scope out loud. Really appreciate you offering real hours to this. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman's offer to help** — gave her a concrete, low-risk, non-public first task: survey the current AI evals/benchmark landscape
